# Eastbright Global

> Eastbright Global is a cross-border marketing consultancy with teams in Taiwan and Kuala Lumpur. It helps brands enter and grow in Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau and Southeast Asia, and helps marketing teams build AI capability they can run on their own.

The website is available in Traditional Chinese (default) and English. Client names, results and methods are not published; they are discussed during a consultation. Project and retainer fees are quoted by scope.

## Services

- [Market Strategy Diagnostic](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#svc-1): competitor analysis, market selection and feasibility, positioning and local messaging strategy (市場策略診斷)
- [Social & Content Marketing](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#svc-2): Threads, Xiaohongshu (RED), Facebook, Instagram and TikTok community management, word-of-mouth, social listening and PR (海外整合行銷)
- [Meta / Google Advertising](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#svc-3): ad strategy, budget allocation, audience setup, creative testing, conversion tracking and reporting (Meta／Google 廣告投放)
- [Creator Partnerships](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#svc-4): screening and matching expert and tech creators (KOLs/KOCs), campaign planning, affiliate programmes and tracking (海外 KOL/KOC 網紅合作)
- [AI Enablement](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#ai): marketing workflow diagnostic, AI collaboration and review process, brand knowledge base, in-house training and adoption support (AI 企業賦能)

## Starter offer

- [Brand Check](https://eastbrightglobal.com/en/#diagnostic): USD 300, delivered in 7 working days. Covers market strategy and priority recommendations, competitor messaging, localisation risks, a recommended next step, red flags and a live online debrief. Fully credited towards a first project started within three months. (跨境品牌檢測)

## Markets

- Taiwan (GMT+8)
- Hong Kong and Macau (GMT+8)
- Southeast Asia, with a team in Kuala Lumpur (GMT+7 / +8)
- Multi-market coordination across the region

## Team

- Yvonne Wang: Co-Founder, Growth Marketing Consultant, based in Taiwan
